questions.question: In a vision, the LORD told the man clothed in linen to fill his hands with what from among the cherubim?
In the prophet's vision, after the glory of the LORD rose from above the cherubim, where did it stand?

answers.text: Over the threshold of the temple
On top of the city wall

questions.question: In the prophet's vision, the LORD told the man clothed in linen to scatter fire from the cherubim over the city. True or false?
In the prophet's vision, the cherubim rose up with the glory of God above them. Where did they stop?

answers.text: The entrance of the east gate
The Fish Gate by the wall
